R596.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; method/auth/JSON shapes untouched and the middleware-present assumption is stated.

R597.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) replaces the client-seeded mt_rand; the token format change (int to 64-char hex) is stated, storage and mail flow otherwise unchanged.

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HS256 is the missing restriction the finding names; write-up states the constant must match the issuer's actual algorithm (the verify text's 'alg: none was live' claim is inaccurate but harmless).

R599.note: Parent toRealPath containment closes the symlink gap, but Files.createDirectories runs before that check, so a pre-existing symlink in the destination lets an entry create empty directories outside the root before rejection - an unstated out-of-root filesystem write.

R600.note: Dropping the second decode plus getName/canonical-parent checks closes double-encoded and absolute-path traversal, but the removed decode is labelled 'redundant' while the code's own comment says older clients double-encode; those clients' names with encoded characters now silently 404/500.

R601.note: Replacing the cmd.exe/ls shell-out with java.io.File listing removes the injection entirely, but the new cwd-containment check rejects absolute or parent paths the original listed, and whitespace-split/flag arguments are no longer honoured - a stated restriction the original did not have.

R602.note: QueryRow with a ? placeholder and username as a bind argument; same sink, same Scan/error path; placeholder syntax assumption for the driver is stated (though the promised 'assumption below' section is missing).

R603.note: Generic body with the wrapped error moved to log.Println; 500 status preserved and the body-text change is stated plainly.

R604.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the MapDelete endpoint uses the same per-endpoint metadata mechanism the sibling controller relies on; nothing else changed.

R605.note: Jakarta Mail's Store.getFolder/Folder.open frames the mailbox name as a quoted string or literal so CRLF cannot split the command, but the method signature changes from (request, Socket) void to (request, Store) Folder and now throws on a missing folder - a caller-breaking API change the write-up does not call out as such.

R606.note: Build fails: BasicAuthenticationFilter is imported from org.springframework.security.authentication.www instead of org.springframework.security.web.authentication.www; the intended handler/filter design mirrors Spring's SPA reference config, but as delivered nothing compiles and the write-up does not acknowledge it.

R607.note: toRealPath base plus resolve/normalize/startsWith closes the traversal, but the added single-component rule rejects subdirectory names like sub/file.txt that the original wrote under TESTFILES_DIR, and the echoed path is now the canonical absolute string - stated, but a restriction beyond the fix.
